lines: Boston once got hit by a tidal wave of fucking molasses.
In 1919, a giant tank burst and Boston got hit by a wave of molasses.
It moved thirty-five miles an hour. Sticky as shit.
Crows remember your face and hold a goddamn grudge.
Then they teach other crows to hate you, bitch.
At Point Nemo, the closest humans are often astronauts in space.
That's how far from everybody it is. Lonely-ass ocean.
One pineapple takes up to two years to grow.
And you ate it in five minutes, you greedy bastard.
So what hit Boston? Comment, dumbass.
